title: Nothing CMF Headphone Pro US$61.20 (~A$86.15) Delivered @ Nothing Online Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: Nothing CMF Headphone Pro US$61.20 (~A$86.15) Delivered @ Nothing Online Store AliExpress

[park it] Where are you seeing the 15% cashback? Showing as 11.25% for me.
[HelpfulMilk] So topcashback UK can be used even though we in Aus? If so how can i use my aus acc for it?
[Clear] Accounts aren't linked. You will have to create an account on TCB UK. Payment is in GBP.
[Agret] I created a topcashback UK account back when they started offering high cashback on AliExpress. Bought a couple items from AliExpress in one transaction and topcashback didn't track anything, you can give it a go but don't rely on it giving you cashback.
[Spector1] if anything the beats 360 are a knock off of these. But they do look interesting
[MrFacetious] Any recommendations for wireless headphones for kids ?
[philotex] The JBL 320BT are alright if you need brand name and your kids have small heads. If your kids don't care, try some EKOs from BigW, good enough and you won't worry about your kids destroying them.
[Herszek] will this be better or at least lighter than the Ugreen studio pro?
[fozzie] These are heavier. Also they don't fold.
[fatbunn] How does this compare to XM3. Have an XM3 and was looking for an upgrade.
[Clear] Always from this store. I've never seen counterfeit Nothing before.
[Wonderfool] They're just Chinese eBay.
So same kind of risk you'll have on eBay.
[will05] Yes , using watch and budz , both genuine and loving it.
